title: Describing Socio-Technological Trends: Teret hódít & Átalakulóban van

sections.title: Narrating Expansion and Ongoing State
sections.content: To describe expanding trends, Hungarian uses 'teret hódít' (gains ground, expands) and the participle átalakuló with -ban: 'átalakulóban van' (is in the process of transforming). You know the participle -ó/-ő from B1 Unit 11 and -ban/-ben from A1.

items.spanish: A mesterséges intelligencia rohamosan teret hódít az iparban.
items.english: Artificial intelligence is rapidly gaining ground in industry.

items.spanish: A hagyományos munka világa alapvetően átalakulóban van.
items.english: The world of traditional work is undergoing a fundamental transformation.

items.spanish: Az online vásárlás egyre nagyobb teret hódít.
items.english: Online shopping is gaining more and more ground.
